BiblicalUsage: Zippor is a Moabite, the father of Balak the king who hired Balaam. In Numbers 22:2, Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites. The fuller story is told on the Zippor profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Zippor shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
